art_direction: View from just inside the modest room toward its open doorway. Pan Zi in olive-gray jacket pauses at the threshold and looks back softly toward the table; Wu Xie waits in the corridor just beyond. In the foreground, the same blue-rimmed bowl and chopsticks remain untouched on the dark wooden table, in a pool of warm lamplight, with a pale enamel kettle behind them. Their pose conveys affection, uncertainty and ordinary haste rather than supernatural knowledge. No additional bowl or duplicated people.
visible_description: 潘子在门边回望，桌上的面与筷子仍在。
poster_text: 他回头看了一眼，那碗面还留在桌上。
source_chapter: 《盗墓笔记8》大结局第七十四章（二）
adaptation_note: 小三爷到门口叫人、出发前回望和离开路上的画面为基于用户叙述的虚构改编；潘子是否预感归期为吴邪的猜测。
